steps.title: Meet Music
steps.text: These blocks let you play drums and notes, pick instruments, and set how fast the music goes. Let's take a quick tour, then build a short tune.

steps.title: Play a drum
steps.text: Choose a drum from the menu and how many beats to play it for. Use this to make a beat.

steps.title: Play a note
steps.text: Pick a note (a bigger number is a higher sound) and how many beats it lasts. Put several in a row to create a song.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: This block stays quiet for a number of beats. Silence between notes makes a tune sound more musical.

steps.title: Choose an instrument
steps.text: Switch the sprite's instrument, like piano, guitar or marimba. Every note it plays afterward uses that instrument.

steps.title: Change the speed
steps.text: The tempo is how fast the beats go. A bigger number is faster. "change tempo by" speeds it up or slows it down a little at a time.

steps.title: Try it yourself!
steps.text: I've added a “when this sprite clicked” block to your code area. Drag “play note” under it, then click your sprite to hear it. Then try adding more notes, a rest, or a drum!

waitFor.label: Drag the “play note” block into the code area
